dashboard.label: TA-devfleet Metrics
dashboard.description: Index-time metrics over index=metrics (sourcetype devfleet:metrics); series prefixed 'devfleet.'.

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-devfleet requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-devfleet", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-devfleet/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms

panel.title: All devfleet.* series (PCI / USB counts, device delta)

search.query: | mstats avg("devfleet.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name, host span=5m | rename v* as "devfleet.*"
